C00PSMLFF.name: C00PSMLFF

angular_weight.description: Non-negative weight applied to the angular feature channel.

LBispectrum.name: LBispectrum
LBispectrum.description: Low-rank bispectrum descriptor with optional element profiles.

rcutfac.description: Positive factor scaling the effective radial cutoff.
